name: Nebraska

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: You may retest; confirm any same-day/next-day rule with your DMV office
retake.retakeFee: A knowledge test fee applies on retakes

gdl.permitMinAge: 15 (School Learner's Permit LPE); a rural School Permit is available at 14 yrs 2 mo
gdl.fullLicenseMinAge: 17 (full Class O operator license restrictions lift)
gdl.permitHoldingPeriod: School Permit pathway: hold the LPE at least 2 months before applying for an SCP; under-18 Class O pathway: hold the POP at least 12 months with fewer than 3 points in the preceding 12 months for test waivers
gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 50 hours (10 at night); may be waived by completing an approved driver education course
gdl.nightCurfew: No driving midnight-6 a.m. on a Provisional Operator's Permit (secondary enforcement)
gdl.passengerLimits: No more than one passenger under 19 for the first 6 months on a POP (secondary enforcement)

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity (e.g. certified birth certificate or U.S. passport)
Two proofs of Nebraska address (for a REAL ID)
process.realIdNotes: A Nebraska REAL ID requires one proof of identity, one proof of Social Security number, and two proofs of Nebraska address. A standard (non-REAL ID) credential is also available.
process.licenseFee: Approximately $28.75 for a 5-year Class O operator license; verify current fee with DMV
process.visionStandard: At least 20/40 in one or both eyes, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 12 points in any 2-year period leads to license revocation
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane or slow down for stopped emergency, tow, and utility vehicles displaying flashing or warning lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 25 mph in a school zone (unless otherwise posted); fines are doubled
